1.web: So these three men ceased to answer Job, because he was righteous in his own eyes.
1.asv: So these three men ceased to answer Job, because he was righteous in his own eyes.

2.web: Then the wrath of Elihu the son of Barachel, the Buzite, of the family of Ram, was kindled against Job. His wrath was kindled because he justified himself rather than God.
2.asv: Then was kindled the wrath of Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite, of the family of Ram: against Job was his wrath kindled, because he justified himself rather than God.

3.web: Also his wrath was kindled against his three friends, because they had found no answer, and yet had condemned Job.
3.asv: Also against his three friends was his wrath kindled, because they had found no answer, and yet had condemned Job.

4.web: Now Elihu had waited to speak to Job, because they were elder than he.
4.asv: Now Elihu had waited to speak unto Job, because they were elder than he.

5.web: When Elihu saw that there was no answer in the mouth of these three men, his wrath was kindled.
5.asv: And when Elihu saw that there was no answer in the mouth of these three men, his wrath was kindled.

6.web: Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite answered, “I am young, and you are very old; Therefore I held back, and didn’t dare show you my opinion.
6.asv: And Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite answered and said, I am young, and ye are very old; Wherefore I held back, and durst not show you mine opinion.

7.web: I said, ‘Days should speak, and multitude of years should teach wisdom.’
7.asv: I said, Days should speak, And multitude of years should teach wisdom.

8.web: But there is a spirit in man, and the breath of the Almighty gives them understanding.
8.asv: But there is a spirit in man, And the breath of the Almighty giveth them understanding.

9.web: It is not the great who are wise, nor the aged who understand justice.
9.asv: It is not the great that are wise, Nor the aged that understand justice.

10.web: Therefore I said, ‘Listen to me; I also will show my opinion.’
10.asv: Therefore I said, Hearken to me; I also will show mine opinion.

11.web: “Behold, I waited for your words, and I listened for your reasoning, while you searched out what to say.
11.asv: Behold, I waited for your words, I listened for your reasonings, Whilst ye searched out what to say.

12.web: Yes, I gave you my full attention, but there was no one who convinced Job, or who answered his words, among you.
12.asv: Yea, I attended unto you, And, behold, there was none that convinced Job, Or that answered his words, among you.

13.web: Beware lest you say, ‘We have found wisdom, God may refute him, not man;’
13.asv: Beware lest ye say, We have found wisdom; God may vanquish him, not man:

14.web: for he has not directed his words against me; neither will I answer him with your speeches.
14.asv: For he hath not directed his words against me; Neither will I answer him with your speeches.

15.web: “They are amazed. They answer no more. They don’t have a word to say.
15.asv: They are amazed, they answer no more: They have not a word to say.

16.web: Shall I wait, because they don’t speak, because they stand still, and answer no more?
16.asv: And shall I wait, because they speak not, Because they stand still, and answer no more?

17.web: I also will answer my part, and I also will show my opinion.
17.asv: I also will answer my part, I also will show mine opinion.

18.web: For I am full of words. The spirit within me constrains me.
18.asv: For I am full of words; The spirit within me constraineth me.

19.web: Behold, my breast is as wine which has no vent; like new wineskins it is ready to burst.
19.asv: Behold, my breast is as wine which hath no vent; Like new wine-skins it is ready to burst.

20.web: I will speak, that I may be refreshed. I will open my lips and answer.
20.asv: I will speak, that I may be refreshed; I will open my lips and answer.

21.web: Please don’t let me respect any man’s person, neither will I give flattering titles to any man.
21.asv: Let me not, I pray you, respect any man’s person; Neither will I give flattering titles unto any man.

22.web: For I don’t know how to give flattering titles; or else my Maker would soon take me away.
22.asv: For I know not to give flattering titles; Elsewould my Maker soon take me away.
